tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description: List country research or inspect one ISO-2 country's capability/access evidence; not live coverage.

tools.name: plan_verification
tools.description: Plan signup_phone, identity_onboarding, payout_account or MX mx_cep_existing_payment (existing SPEI evidence). CEP only discovers the separate authenticated trial; never submit transaction data here. Set stage=production to report missing live routes; legacy event-only calls remain supported.

tools.name: create_sandbox_verification
tools.description: Return a synthetic match/mismatch/not_found/timeout/unsupported fixture. Never provide personal data.

tools.name: get_sandbox_verification
tools.description: Retrieve a deterministic sim_v1 fixture, not a real transaction.

tools.name: explain_result
tools.description: Explain a sandbox reason code; missing data and timeout remain inconclusive.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "plan_verification" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Plan onboarding, payout or account_change; returns research requirements and sandbox example." → after: "Plan signup_phone, identity_onboarding, payout_account or MX mx_cep_existing_payment (existing SPEI evidence). CEP only discovers the separate authenticated trial; never submit transaction data here. Set stage=production to report missing live routes; legacy event-only calls remain supported."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
